To protect your health, check air quality levels and act as needed:

* When Air Quality Index (AQI) levels are "Unhealthy for
Sensitive Groups" (orange), sensitive groups as specified
above should limit extended or intense outdoor activity.
* When AQI is "Unhealthy" (red), everyone may experience health
impacts. Sensitive groups should avoid extended time outdoors.
* When AQI is "Very Unhealthy" (purple), sensitive groups should
avoid all outdoor physical activity. Everyone else should
avoid extended or intense outdoor activity.
* When AQI is "Hazardous" (maroon), everyone should avoid all
outdoor physical activity.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

.WIND INFORMATION...
North to northeast winds of 15 to 25 mph will turn toward the
southeast and increase through Friday as Choi-wan moves west
across the northern CNMI and strengthens, potentially becoming a
typhoon Friday night to the west of Alamagan and Pagan as it turns
to the north. Tropical storm force winds of 39 to 50 mph look to
continue through Sunday. Depending on the track and intensity,
winds may increase to strong tropical storm-force of 58 to 65 mph
early Saturday morning. Typhoon force winds greater than 74 mph
look to remain possible during closest passage.

.COASTAL INUNDATION AND SURF INFORMATION...
Surf will initially build to 8 to 12 feet along east-facing reefs
through Friday morning, then spread along north and west-facing
reefs as the center moves north-northeast west of the northern
CNMI Friday night through Saturday night, increasing by several
feet during this time. As Choi-wan continues to strengthen, surf
will continue to increase, likely becoming dangerous by early next
week. Significant coastal erosion and some coastal inundation is
expected during Choi-wan's passage.

.OTHER STORM EFFECTS...
Periods of rain, widespread heavy showers and scattered thunderstorms
could produce rainfall totals of 10 to 16 inches by early Monday
morning, with up to 20 inches of rainfall possible near the center of
the system.

and some coastal inundation remain possible as Choi-wan moves away.
